decisionContext.northStar: Long-term approved affiliate revenue per relevant visitor; truthful consumer value and SEO trust first.
decisionContext.design: Owner-approved 2026-10-09 direction: premium warm-white, dark navy/blue primary, restrained pastels, generous white space; first mockup's look but less visual density. Lyst interaction delight + The Zebra progressive questions + KAYAK optional deep comparisons. Roll out in bounded QA-backed slices. See VISUAL_UX_ROADMAP_2026-10-09.md.

decisionContext.pricing: Electricity quarter-hour spot feed SE1-SE4 is real, but NOT a per-provider offer feed. No fabricated cheapest provider, 'best choice', monthly quote, ratings, guaranteed saving or extrapolated shift savings.
decisionContext.experimentStatus: No active growth experiment in autopilot/state.json as of 2026-10-09; do not treat merged UX releases as commercially proven experiments.
decisionContext.capacity: Independent non-paid traffic acquisition remains the highest commercial constraint; continue alongside design. No paid media or contracts without owner approval.
